status: Frozen training-evidence mechanism before this preview; a new learner proposal, not adopted final service or validated market improvement.

scope.preview_units: six saved full/refit training fits only

inner_sets.eligible: Use the original complete-H inner conditional-auto risk screen, including auto_n>0. Keep every eligible beta separately.
inner_sets.top_E: Among risk-eligible betas, retain exact maximum automatic validation path count. Within that coverage retain every beta whose mean auto annual log growth is >= the single global maximum minus1e-12. Sort E numerically; do not collapse E by the old minimum-beta tie.
inner_sets.behavior_classes: Separately group complete saved per-original-validation-path job/case/status/admission/selected-price vectors. E is not all eligible and is not a behavior-equivalence class. Never enlarge E using outcome equivalence.

refit_rule.case_priority: Use effective Q1 assignment before execution admission. Review -> risk_review, Cons/Grow -> not_balanced_case; both have no Q2 investment outcome and no fallback.
refit_rule.E_empty: Balanced case with E empty -> execution_review/no_top_inner_beta.
refit_rule.within_E_only: For beta in ascending E, apply the unchanged saved-nine-price training selection. Require whole-policy training k <= min(kB,floor(beta*n+1e-12)); beta never exceeds alpha=.1. Choose the first beta with any feasible price, then that beta's old maximum-G/single-global-band/original-price-order winner.
refit_rule.E_all_refit_fail: If every E beta has no admissible saved training price, execution_review; do not try a beta outside E, reference B, a different menu or another controller family.
refit_rule.difference_from_old: This adds refit feasibility only within the equally top inner-evidence set, and therefore defines a new learner. The old smallest-beta rule and all its archived outcomes remain unchanged.

restrictions: No client_paths.csv, outer finance, branch/counterfactual outcome or external test outcome may be read.
No saved training choice is rerun on actual or validation markets; no formerly rejected outer path receives a return.
Mechanical training admission differences are not OOF coverage improvement, validated risk, customer preference identification or winner selection.
The refit n, all9 full-training counts/growth, static target/Q1 case and reference kB remain exactly the saved parent evidence.
Source/evidence SHA must match before and after; all old algorithms/protocols/results remain read-only.
Any future evaluation must first freeze and evaluate the full new learner; the preview cannot relabel old OOF.
